messages.content: amar crush amake ekdom ignore kore ajkal, ki hoyeche bujhtechi na
Ignore mane exactly ki - reply kom dey, naki completely avoid kore?
reply dey but onek late kore, ar short answer dey
That could mean a few things - busy phase, losing interest, or just their normal texting style shifting. Age ki normal chilo eta?
na age onek active chilo, ekhon completely different
A clear shift like that is worth actually asking about directly, rather than guessing endlessly. Kichu bolechile jeta unintentionally off putting hote pare?
